excerpt.zh:
[Target.GetAdj]双星系统的光芒照耀着我们的货运飞船驶入[Target.capital_scope.Solar_System.GetName]。

他们的货物，数以百万计的微型噬星者，在绝对零度下储存，以确保它们稳定而惰性，直到将他们送到恒星系的主恒星。货运飞船需要继续保持静默飞行一段时间，以便进一步渗透[Target.GetSpeciesAdj]首都。
excerpt.en:
The light of the [Target.GetAdj] twin stars shone down on our transport ship as it entered the [Target.capital_scope.Solar_System.GetName] system.

Their cargo - millions of tiny Stellar Devourers - is stored at absolute zero, which keeps them docile and inert

scope.zh: 吞噬恒星间谍行动三阶段、发起方确认、目标方的恒星变冷、局势、治愈项目与两种结局。
scope.en: The three operation stages, the operator's confirmation, the target's cooling star, the situation, the cure project and both endings.

label.en: The star dies or is cured

note.zh: 进度100%时1170恒星熄灭；完成项目后方式改为“治愈恒星”（每月-7），降到0时隐藏1175移除修正并静默结束。
note.en: At 100% the star dies (1170); after the project the approach becomes 'Cure the Star' (net -7 per month) and at 0 hidden 1175 removes the modifiers and ends it silently.

texts.zh:
[Target.GetAdj]双星系统的光芒照耀着我们的货运飞船驶入[Target.capital_scope.Solar_System.GetName]。

他们的货物，数以百万计的微型噬星者，在绝对零度下储存，以确保它们稳定而惰性，直到将他们送到恒星系的主恒星。货运飞船需要继续保持静默飞行一段时间，以便进一步渗透[Target.GetSpeciesAdj]首都。
texts.en:
The light of the [Target.GetAdj] twin stars shone down on our transport ship as it entered the [Target.capital_scope.Solar_System.GetName] system.

Their cargo - millions of tiny Stellar Devourers - is stored at absolute zero, which keeps them docile and inert until they are ready to be introduced to the system's primary star. The transport ship will have to go dark for a while as they further infiltrate the [Target.GetSpeciesAdj] capital.

texts.zh:
构成[Target.GetName]核心的星光三重奏照耀着我们的货运飞船的船体驶入[Target.capital_scope.Solar_System.GetName]星系。

他们的货物，数以百万计的微型噬星者，在绝对零度下储存，以确保它们稳定而惰性，直到将他们送到恒星系的主恒星。货运飞船需要继续保持静默飞行一段时间，以便进一步渗透[Target.GetSpeciesAdj]首都。
texts.en:
The trio of lights that form the heart of the [Target.GetName] glinted off our transport ship's hull as it entered the S[Target.capital_scope.Solar_System.GetName] system.

Their cargo - millions of tiny Stellar Devourers - is stored at absolute zero, which keeps them docile and inert until they are ready to be introduced to the system's primary star. The transport ship will have to go dark for a while as they further infiltrate the [Target.GetSpeciesAdj] capital.

texts.zh:
在踏出了驶向赐予[Target.capital_star.GetName]生命恒星的旅途的第一步之后，我们的货运飞船仍在继续挺进[Target.GetName]宇域。

他们的货物，数以百万计的微型噬星者，在绝对零度下储存，以确保它们稳定而惰性，直到将他们送到恒星系的主恒星。货运飞船需要继续保持静默飞行一段时间，以便进一步渗透[Target.GetSpeciesAdj]首都。
texts.en:
After having finished the first leg of their journey to the life-giving [Target.capital_star.GetName] star, our transport ship ventures further into [Target.GetName] space.

Their cargo - millions of tiny Stellar Devourers - is stored at absolute zero, which keeps them docile and inert until they are ready to be introduced to the system's primary star. The transport ship will have to go dark for a while as they further infiltrate the [Target.GetSpeciesAdj] capital.

notes.zh: 间谍行动“吞噬恒星”（250影响力、60间谍力量）要求发起国拥有带“噬星者战利品”修正的星球（来自利维坦庆典中的噬星者庆典）；目标首都不能是黑洞、未曾研究过侵染、首都星系无戴森球。1125–1140由发起国阅读，1145起由目标国阅读。
notes.en: The espionage operation 'Consume Star' (250 influence, 60 spy power) requires the operator to own a planet with the Stellar Devourer trophy modifier (from the Stellar Devourer celebration of the leviathan celebration situation); the target capital must not orbit a black hole, the target must not have studied the infestation, and its capital system has no Dyson Sphere. 1125–1140 are read by the operator, 1145 onward by the target.

texts.zh: 运载噬星者的货运飞船已经通过了恒星系的安全检查，其中使用的密码是此前由间谍首脑[spynetwork.leader.GetName]所捕获的，这对顺利通行至关重要。我们的操作员已经开始将这些噬星者宝宝重新解冻以恢复其活动。货运飞船将再次瞄准恒星系的首要恒星，作为这次旅途的终点。
texts.en: Our Stellar Devourer transport has cleared the system's security check - the security codes that Spymaster [spynetwork.leader.GetName] has been gathering were crucial for passing into the system. Our operatives have started the heating procedure to get the baby Stellar Devourers moving. They will again aim for the system's primary star for the transport ship's final voyage.

title.zh: 离开货运飞船，进入燃烧的等离子体
title.en: Out of the Transport Ship, Into the Burning Plasma

texts.zh:
我们已经收到来自间谍首脑[spynetwork.leader.GetName]的密电：一切就绪。我们的操作员已经开始弃船操作，只保留下核心船员。一旦舰船加速到最大的亚光速航速，他们也会在飞船撞击这个星系的首要恒星之前脱离，以确保我们不留下任何蛛丝马迹。

噬星者宝宝们已经开始躁动不安。如果我们再不快点执行操作，它们可能都要开始打起飞船燃料的主意了。
texts.en:
We have received word back from Spymaster [spynetwork.leader.GetName]: everything is ready. Our operatives have already started abandoning the transport ship, leaving only a skeleton crew behind. Once the ship hits its maximum sublight speed, they too will escape just before the transport crashes into the system's primary star, ensuring we leave no evidence behind.

The Stellar Devourers have started to get quite agitated. If we don't commence the operation soon, they might make their way into the transport's fuel supply.

texts.zh:
我们干预行动的最后证据很快在恒星的日冕层熔化了。我们的传感器在撞击后的一瞬间焚毁，但这足以证明我们已经成功地感染了[From.target.capital_star.GetName]。

我们已经为这个恒星系写下了残酷而寒冷的终章。
texts.en:
The last proof of our tampering quickly melted inside the star's corona. Our sensors burned up moments after impact, but that was enough to confirm that we had successfully infested [From.target.capital_star.GetName].

We may just have doomed an entire solar system to a cruel, cold death.

texts.zh:
我们的[capital_star.GetName]遭遇了一场异常的恒星活动低谷期。由于温度的降低，恒星黑子以史无前例的数量大量出现，让恒星的辐射发生了非常明显的衰弱。

[capital_scope.GetName]上的居民已经开始囤积核热毯，减少外出。希望我们能尽早回到温暖的日子。
texts.en:
We are experiencing an unusually inactive solar cycle from [capital_star.GetName]. Sunspots have appeared in unprecedented numbers because of the reduced temperature of our star, leading to a noticeable decrease in solar radiation.

Inhabitants of [capital_scope.GetName] have taken to stocking up on fission-powered blankets and minimizing trips outside. Hopefully, we will return to warmer times soon.

texts.zh:
我们的[capital_star.GetName]遭遇了一场异常的恒星活动低谷期。由于温度的降低，恒星黑子以史无前例的数量大量出现，让恒星的辐射发生了非常明显的衰弱。

我们已经分派了更多的能量用于产热，并指示所有子个体凑成团簇一同行动以减少热量散失。我们一定能熬过去的。
texts.en:
We are experiencing an unusually inactive solar cycle from [capital_star.GetName]. Sunspots have appeared in unprecedented numbers because of the reduced temperature of our star, leading to a noticeable decrease in solar radiation.

We have allocated more energy to our heating budget and have instructed all drones to huddle closer to each other to preserve heat. We will endure this.

texts.zh:
我们的[capital_star.GetName]遭遇了一场异常的恒星活动低谷期。由于温度的降低，恒星黑子以史无前例的数量大量出现，让恒星的辐射发生了非常明显的衰弱。

尽管这场骚动触动了我们共同本能深处的恐惧，但鉴于我们知晓母星此前造成的破坏：我们将坚持下去。我们已分配更多能量用于供暖我们的庇护所，而我们的共生体们也将学会为了取暖而更加紧密地依偎在一起。
texts.en:
We are experiencing an unusually inactive solar cycle from [capital_star.GetName]. Sunspots have appeared in unprecedented numbers because of the reduced temperature of our star, leading to a noticeable decrease in solar radiation.

Though this disturbance strikes fear into the core of our shared instincts, knowing the damage our home star has wreaked before: we shall endure. We have allocated more energy for heating our sheltered dwellings, and our symbionts shall learn to huddle closer to each other for warmth.

texts.zh: [capital_star.GetName]内部的聚变反应持续低迷的时长前所未见。由于其辐照能量的骤减，[capital_scope.GetName]上已经发生了多种生态灾害，如果继续下去，我们可能将面临冰河时期。所有的空间站和定居点都遭遇到了相似的情况。我们的[owner.GetScientistPlural]确信一定有什么蹊跷，希望能研究[capital_star.GetName]。
texts.en: The fusion chain reaction inside of [capital_star.GetName] has now been on a steady downturn for an unprecedented amount of time. There are active ecological disasters on [capital_scope.GetName] due to the lowered radiation, and if this continues, we might be looking at an ice age. All stations and other places of residence in the system are suffering from similar issues. Our [owner.GetScientistPlural] are sure that there is something abnormal afoot and desire to investigate [capital_star.GetName].

label.zh: 查查到底发生了什么事！
label.en: Figure out what is going on!

texts.zh: 我们的恒星[Target.GetName]最近的行为极度怪异，它的能量产出远远低于平常。如果不能尽快找到应对措施，我们将会面临生态灾难！
texts.en: Our star, [Target.GetName], has been acting extremely oddly recently, generating a lot less energy than usual. If this is not remedied soon we could be facing ecological disaster!

notes.zh: 初始10%，基础每月+3，默认方式“寻找治愈方法”下净+2。20%时隐藏1155加重修正；50%时1160。是否得知凶手取决于目标对发起国的加密/解密比较。
notes.en: Starts at 10%, base +3 per month, net +2 under the default 'Search for a Cure'. At 20% hidden 1155 worsens the modifiers; at 50% comes 1160. Whether the target learns who did it depends on its encryption/decryption against the operator.

texts.zh: [capital_star.GetName]被微型噬星者感染了！我们不明白这些星神兽幼体到底是怎么跑到我们的恒星上的，明明它们不具有任何超光速能力。我们可以在未来对其进行研究，但当下我们最要紧的是研究如何停止它们的寄生，否则我们的整个首都就要被彻底冻死了。
texts.en: [capital_star.GetName] is infested with tiny Stellar Devourers! We have no clue how these neonate leviathans have managed to get to our star as they don't seem to possess any FTL capabilities. We can uncover all that later. For now, we need to discover a way to stop the parasites before our capital freezes over.

label.en: Well, get them out of there!

title.zh: 找到噬星者寄生的解决方案。
title.en: Find a Cure for the Stellar Devourer Infestation

texts.zh: [This.GetName]受到噬星者的寄生。我们不确定它们从何而来，只知道必须尽快移除它们，否则星系内的所有生命都将在劫难逃。
texts.en: [This.GetName] has become infested with Stellar Devourers. We are unsure where they came from, but they need to be removed soon or else all life in the system might be at an end.

note.zh: 隐藏1165把局势方式设为治愈；进度归零后隐藏1175静默结束，不再有窗口。
note.en: Hidden 1165 switches the situation to the cure approach; when progress reaches 0, hidden 1175 ends it silently with no further window.

texts.zh:
今天对[owner.GetName]而言是地狱般的一天，我们的首都恒星[target.GetName]熄灭了。尽管有数百万人撤离，但这对于我们遭受的打击来说不过杯水车薪。我们的首都永远地陷入了冰河时期。[target.GetName]则缩水成了一颗褐矮星，这就意味着这个恒星系里任何生命都不再适合生存了。
我们推测这些噬星者很有可能是由[star_infesters.GetName]送到我们的恒星上的，现在我们要他们血债血偿。
texts.en:
Today was a terrible day for the [owner.GetName], as our capital star [target.GetName] went out. Despite having evacuated many millions it only slightly softens the blow. Our capital is forever lost to a new and permanent ice age. [target.GetName] itself has shrunken to become a brown dwarf star, meaning life remaining in the system will permanently be diminished.
We know that these Devourers were purposely introduced to our star by the [star_infesters.GetName] - and now they shall suffer.

texts.zh:
今天对[owner.GetName]而言是地狱般的一天，我们的首都恒星[target.GetName]熄灭了。尽管有数百万人撤离，但这对于我们遭受的打击来说不过杯水车薪。我们的首都永远地陷入了冰河时期。[target.GetName]则缩水成了一颗褐矮星，这就意味着这个恒星系里任何生命都不再适合生存了。
很遗憾，究竟是什么把这些噬星者带到我们星系的仍不得而知。目前是灾后重建的时候了。
texts.en:
Today was a terrible day for the [owner.GetName], as our capital star [target.GetName] went out. Despite having evacuated many millions it only slightly softens the blow. Our capital is forever lost to a new and permanent ice age. [target.GetName] itself has shrunken to become a brown dwarf star, meaning life remaining in the system will permanently be diminished.
Sadly, this freak occurrence that delivered the Stellar Devourers to our system will remain a mystery. For now, we must rebuild.

note.zh: 恒星变为褐矮星，星系内殖民地被摧毁并冰冻；若知道凶手，可获得复仇宣战理由。
note.en: The star becomes a brown dwarf and the system's colonies are destroyed and frozen; if the culprit is known, a revenge casus belli is granted.

summary.text:
# 吞噬恒星 / Consume Star

- 分类 Category：文明纪事 Society (C7) · 间谍行动 espionage operation · 审阅 Reviewed 2026-10-12
- 来源 Sources：`common/espionage_operation_types/operations.txt:1133-1222`；`events/situation_events.txt:5380-5770`；`common/situations/01_narrative_situations.txt:1135-1251`；`common/special_projects/00_projects_leviathans.txt:508-534`；`common/scripted_effects/00_scripted_effects.txt:5994-5996`（噬星者战利品）

## 如何开始 How it starts

- 由玩家（或 AI）发动间谍行动“吞噬恒星”开始（250 影响力、60 间谍力量、三个阶段）。前提：发起国拥有带“噬星者战利品”修正的星球——来自利维坦庆典中的噬星者庆典；目标首都不环绕黑洞、首都星系没有戴森球、目标尚未研究过这种侵染（另检查 `infested_star` 标记；1135 设置的是 `has_infested_star`，两者名称不同，评注）。
  It starts when an empire runs the espionage operation "Consume Star" (250 influence, 60 spy power, three stages). Requirement: the operator owns a planet with the Stellar Devourer trophy modifier — from the Stellar Devourer celebration of the leviathan celebration situation; the target's capital does not orbit a black hole, its capital system has no Dyson Sphere, and the target has not studied this infestation (the allow also checks a flag `infested_star`, while 1135 sets `has_infested_star` — commentary: the names differ).

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

1. 发起方视角 Operator's view：1125「飞梭扑火」运输船载着冷冻的幼年噬星者潜入目标首都星系（正文按单星、双星、三星不同）→ 1130「旧版密码」通过安检 → 1135 下令行动 → 1140「成功感染」：确认目标首都恒星已被感染。
   1125 "Transverse Orientation": a transport carrying frozen baby Stellar Devourers slips into the target capital system (texts for single, binary and trinary stars) → 1130 "Older Codes" passes security → 1135 launches → 1140 "Successful Infestation" confirms the target's capital star is infested.
2. 目标方视角 Target's view：60 天后 1145「恒星能量亏损」（殖民地获得低恒星输出修正；普通/格式塔/荒野三种写法）→ 180 天后 1150「凛冬已至」→ 开启局势「受侵蚀的（恒星）」。
   60 days later 1145 "Solar Energy Wanes" (colonies get a low-stellar-output modifier; regular/gestalt/wilderness texts) → 180 days later 1150 "Great Chill" → starts the situation "Infested (star)".
3. 局势初始 10%，基础每月 +3（默认方式净 +2）；20% 时修正加重（隐藏 1155），50% 时 1160「发现寄生虫」开启 450 天的特殊项目“找到噬星者寄生的解决方案”（科研船 + 科学家）。是否得知凶手取决于加密与解密的比较。
   The situation starts at 10% with base +3 per month (net +2 under the default approach); at 20% the modifiers worsen (hidden 1155); at 50% 1160 "Parasites Found" opens a 450-day special project (science ship + scientist). Whether the target learns who did it depends on encryption versus decryption.

## 分支与结局 Branches and outcomes

- 项目完成 → 隐藏 1165：方式改为“治愈恒星”（每月净 -7）；进度降到 0 时隐藏 1175 移除修正，局势静默结束（没有窗口）。
  Project done → hidden 1165 switches to "Cure the Star" (net -7 per month); at 0 hidden 1175 removes the modifiers and the situation ends silently (no window).
- 来不及治愈，进度达 100% → 1170「（恒星）熄灭」：首都恒星变为褐矮星，星系内殖民地被摧毁并冰冻。若知道凶手，可选“必将付出代价”获得 20 年的复仇宣战理由；否则只能哀叹。
  If the cure is too late and progress reaches 100% → 1170 "(star) Extinguished": the capital star becomes a brown dwarf and the system's colonies are destroyed and frozen. If the culprit is known, "shall pay" grants a 20-year revenge casus belli; otherwise only lament.
- 两种结局互斥。 The two endings are exclusive.

## 条件与文明差异 Conditions and variants

- 1125 正文按恒星数量，1145 按普通/格式塔/荒野帝国，1170 按是否知道凶手变化。
  1125 varies with the number of stars, 1145 with regular/gestalt/wilderness empires, 1170 with whether the culprit is known.

## 审阅记录 Review notes

- 已核对：行动定义（费用、前提、三阶段）、1125–1180 全部事件（含隐藏 1155/1165/1175）、局势定义（阶段、方式、进度）、治愈项目。
  Checked: the operation definition (cost, requirements, three stages), all events 1125–1180 (including hidden 1155/1165/1175), the situation definition (stages, approaches, progress) and the cure project.
- 更正 Corrections：草稿把三个行动阶段列为三个并列入口，现按行动阶段顺序串联；结局补充“治愈”分支说明（无窗口）。
  The draft listed the three operation stages as parallel entries; they are now chained in stage order; the silent "cure" ending is documented.
- 视角说明 Perspective：1125–1140 与 1145–1170 属于不同帝国，阅读时需注意。
  1125–1140 and 1145–1170 belong to different empires.
